description: VP Product and key champion departed Jan 2026. New head favors competing platform. DAU crashed from 72% to 28%. No executive contact in 60+ days.
Feature adoption breadth collapsed after platform migration. Support tickets surged 3x. Customer sentiment trending negative.
CFO mandated 20% SaaS spend reduction. Platform under review. Login frequency dropped sharply as team explores alternatives.
Key accounts evaluating competitor after product launch gap. Engagement declining but not critical. Need proactive value reinforcement.
Implementation stalled at 60% completion. Time-to-first-value exceeding target by 3x. Customer patience wearing thin.
